subject.title: [Feature]: Overview should show config file path

question: Should OpenClaw surface the existing admin-scoped configPath in the Overview snapshot card, move it to a Settings/Config information area, or keep config-path discovery CLI-only?
rationale: The technical path is small, but the visible placement of an absolute local path is a UI/product decision and the active PR still needs maintainer acceptance plus proof.

options.title: Accept Overview row
options.body: Land the display-only Overview row after the active PR is rebased and proves the running Control UI behavior.

options.title: Move to Settings
options.body: Ask for the same existing snapshot/config path to be surfaced in a Settings or Config information area instead of Overview.

options.title: Keep CLI-only
options.body: Close this direction if maintainers decide the existing CLI/config surfaces are enough and no prominent UI exposure should be added.

recommendation.title: Accept Overview row
recommendation.body: Land the display-only Overview row after the active PR is rebased and proves the running Control UI behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest feature-history signal for the Overview structure that would receive the visible row.
